title: pinRequest v1
description: Dock to Harbor.Shell, on the control channel: the user asked the dock to pin or unpin an app (docs/adr/0010). The Shell changes settings.json and answers with dockItems; the dock changes nothing until then. Lengths count Unicode characters (code points); control characters are not allowed. Any change to this message bumps v.

kind.description: As in dockItems. app: an AppUserModelID. path: an absolute path to an .exe or .lnk.
